job.title: PMO Lead
job.description:
Our client is a leading provider of advanced visualization and display solutions, delivering innovative technology and engaging digital experiences for major organisations across a diverse range of industries.

They are now looking to appoint an experienced Director of Project Management Office (PMO) to establish and lead project governance, delivery standards and portfolio management across the organisation.

This is a senior leadership position with significant visibility across the business. You will work closely with the executive leadership team and functional leaders to ensure strategic initiatives are appropriately prioritised, effectively resourced and consistently delivered.

The successful candidate will combine strong PMO and portfolio management expertise with the leadership skills required to develop project teams, influence senior stakeholders and drive greater consistency and accountability across a complex, cross-functional organisation.

Key Responsibilities

PMO Leadership & Strategy

  • Establish, develop and continuously improve the organisation's PMO structure, processes and governance framework.
  • Define and embed project management standards, methodologies and best practices across waterfall, agile and hybrid environments.
  • Ensure the project portfolio remains aligned with strategic business objectives and executive priorities.
  • Provide executive leadership with clear reporting and insight into portfolio health, performance, risks and key metrics.

Portfolio & Programme Management

  • Oversee the full lifecycle of major projects and programmes, ensuring delivery against agreed scope, timelines and budgets.
  • Prioritise and balance the project portfolio according to strategic value, organisational capacity and risk.
  • Establish consistent processes for the intake, assessment, prioritisation and approval of new initiatives.
  • Maintain visibility of project dependencies, risks and overall portfolio performance.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor and develop a team of project managers and programme leaders.
  • Establish clear performance expectations, KPIs and development pathways for the team.
  • Build a culture centred around accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Sales, Operations, Engineering and other functional leaders to enable effective project execution.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for critical project challenges and cross-functional issues.
  • Create strong communication and alignment between project teams, functional stakeholders and executive leadership.

Resource Management & Governance

  • Optimise the allocation of resources across the project portfolio to improve efficiency and utilisation.
  • Identify, manage and mitigate risks relating to project scope, schedules and costs.
  • Develop and maintain standardised project management tools, templates and reporting frameworks.
  • Implement effective systems for monitoring project performance, risks and dependencies.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives designed to improve organisational efficiency and project delivery outcomes.

About You

You will be an established project, programme or PMO leader who is comfortable operating at both strategic and operational levels. You will have experience introducing structure and governance while retaining the flexibility required to operate successfully within a fast-moving, cross-functional business.

You should bring:

  • 10+ years of progressive project and/or programme management experience.
  • At least 5 years' leadership experience managing project managers, programme leaders or a PMO function.
  • Experience working within complex, cross-functional environments such as manufacturing, technology integration or a comparable sector.
  • Advanced project, programme and portfolio management expertise.
  • Strong strategic thinking and executive-level communication skills.
  • Demonstrable experience developing and leading high-performing teams.
  • Strong financial awareness and resource-planning capability.
  • Excellent risk management and problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to influence effectively across all levels of an organisation.

A Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering or a related discipline is expected, with an MBA or other advanced qualification advantageous.

PMP certification is required or strongly preferred. Additional qualifications such as PgMP, PMI-ACP, Lean or Six Sigma would also be beneficial.

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a strategically important PMO function within an established technology-led organisation serving major customers across multiple industries.

You will have the opportunity to shape how projects are governed and delivered across the business, develop the organisation's project management capability and work directly with senior leadership on the prioritisation and execution of key strategic initiatives.

The organisation offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision and prescription coverage, life and disability insurance, a 401(k) programme with company match, and access to financial planning support.

job.title: Sales Manager (West Coast, US) - Control Rooms
job.description:
Our client is an established manufacturer and provider of professional display and visualization technology, delivering solutions for complex, high-performance environments across the United States.

They are looking to appoint an experienced Control Room Display Sales Manager to develop business across the Western U.S., with a particular focus on control rooms, command centres and other mission-critical visualization environments.

This is a new-business-focused sales role suited to someone who understands the wider control room and professional AV ecosystem – whether your background is in LED, large-format displays, video walls, visualization, AV systems, command and control technology or an adjacent solution.

Rather than simply managing an existing book of business, you will be expected to identify projects early, develop relationships with end users and the consultant/integrator community, and influence opportunities before they reach formal specification or RFP stage.

Target Markets

The role will develop opportunities across environments including:

  • Control rooms and command centres
  • Utilities and energy operations
  • Manufacturing and process control
  • Public safety and emergency operations
  • Police, fire and traffic management
  • Airport and transportation operations
  • Network and security operations centres
  • Corporate command and monitoring environments
  • Critical infrastructure and other mission-critical facilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop a strong pipeline of new control room, command centre and visualization opportunities across the Western U.S.
  • Identify projects at an early stage and engage customers before formal tender or RFP processes begin.
  • Build relationships with end users, consultants, AV integrators, engineers and other technology partners.
  • Develop strategic accounts from initial prospecting through specification, partner engagement, commercial negotiation and close.
  • Understand customer operational requirements and translate them into appropriate display and visualization solutions.
  • Engage confidently with technical and commercial stakeholders including consultants, engineers, operations teams, procurement and senior decision-makers.
  • Build and manage relationships with regional integrators and channel partners.
  • Support partners through joint account planning, opportunity qualification, technical positioning and customer engagement.
  • Influence specifications and project requirements through consultative, value-led selling.
  • Work closely with internal engineering, project management, product and commercial teams throughout complex sales cycles.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity, pipeline, forecasting and account information within CRM.
  • Represent the business at customer meetings, site visits, consultant briefings, partner meetings and relevant industry events.

About You

We are interested in speaking with sales professionals who have experience selling display, visualization, AV or related technology into control room and mission-critical environments.

You do not necessarily need to come directly from an LED manufacturer. Relevant backgrounds could include video walls, LCD, dvLED, projection, visualization platforms, AV integration, control room technology or adjacent infrastructure solutions.

Ideally, you will bring:

  • 5+ years of experience selling complex AV, display, visualization, control room, command centre, IT, security or mission-critical technology solutions.
  • A strong understanding of how control room and visualization projects are designed, specified and purchased.
  • A track record of generating net-new opportunities rather than relying solely on inbound leads or established accounts.
  • Experience working through AV integrators, consultants, engineers and other channel partners.
  • The ability to hold credible technical conversations around display and visualization requirements.
  • Experience navigating long, specification-led sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong prospecting, discovery, account planning, presentation, negotiation and closing skills.
  • Good commercial discipline around pipeline management, forecasting and CRM.

Existing relationships within the control room consultant, AV integrator, utilities, transportation, public safety, manufacturing or critical-infrastructure communities would be particularly valuable.

The Person

This role will suit someone who enjoys building a territory and creating opportunities rather than waiting for them to arrive.

You will be commercially driven but technically credible, capable of developing relationships from the operational level through to consultants, integrators and senior customer stakeholders.

You should also understand that major control room projects can have long and complex sales cycles. Success will require persistence, strong relationship building and the ability to position yourself early enough in a project to influence its eventual direction.

Location

The territory covers the Western United States, and candidates should ideally be located in a major metro with good access to regional airports and key customer markets.

Regular travel will be required for customer development, partner meetings, site visits, industry events and active project pursuits.

job.title: Junior Camera Engineer
job.description:
Christy Media Solutions is recruiting for a Junior Camera Engineer on behalf of our client, offering an excellent opportunity for someone at the beginning of their engineering career to develop within the world of cinematic broadcast technology.

Our client works at the intersection of cinematic and broadcast workflows, and is looking for someone with strong technical foundations who can learn from an experienced engineering team and progressively build their practical expertise.

The role

Working under the supervision of experienced engineers, you will support the technical team across project preparation and engineering activities. This will include exposure to infrastructure builds, workflow discussions and planning, R&D and technical equipment.

As your knowledge and confidence develop, you will also begin assisting the engineering team on location across a variety of projects.

The supplied role specification also includes testing and maintaining technical equipment, identifying and reporting damaged or missing components, carrying out repairs where possible and supporting visiting clients with equipment demonstrations.

What we're looking for

You'll need a good foundational technical understanding, ideally relating to broadcast, film or television. Knowledge of areas such as networks, signals, signal flows and broadcast workflows will be particularly relevant.

We're also looking for someone who is:

  • Confident and able to communicate effectively
  • Curious, flexible and enthusiastic about learning
  • Proactive with a problem-solving mindset
  • Organised with strong attention to detail
  • Interested in cameras, lenses and cinematic technology
  • Comfortable using macOS and Windows systems

Education and/or experience relating to film, broadcast or engineering is required. Direct professional industry experience is not essential, making this particularly relevant to graduates or candidates at an early stage of their career.

Knowledge of professional camera, lighting and sound equipment is relevant, while familiarity with manufacturers such as ARRI, Sony, Zeiss and Canon would also be useful.

A full clean driving licence is desirable but not essential.

Development

This is a role designed around learning and progression. You'll initially spend significant time training, shadowing experienced engineers and developing your understanding of the company's workflows and technology.

As you become ready to take on more responsibility, you'll gain increasing exposure to on-location projects and the opportunity to develop into a more experienced engineering position.

Salary & working arrangements

The base salary is between £28,000-£30,000

As you progress into formal location work, there is the potential to earn additional location fees and overtime. The initial training period is expected to be approximately six months, during which training/shadowing on location would not attract location fees.

If you're technically minded, confident, keen to learn and looking to build a career combining broadcast engineering with cinematic technology, we'd be keen to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more.

job.title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
job.description:
Our client is an innovative and rapidly growing manufacturer at the forefront of networked AV technology. Their solutions are deployed across enterprise, education, government, healthcare and commercial environments worldwide, delivering high-performance AV-over-IP, IPTV and next-generation audio networking technologies.

As they continue to expand, they are seeking a Senior Technical Support Engineer to join their Technical Services team.

Working closely with Product Management and Engineering, you'll support systems integrators, consultants and enterprise customers through the deployment, optimisation and troubleshooting of sophisticated AV ecosystems.

The Role

You'll act as a senior technical resource, resolving complex issues across enterprise networking, AV transport, control systems and DSP while helping customers maximise the performance of their deployments.

Working directly with systems integrators, consultants and end users, you'll collaborate closely with Engineering and Product teams to investigate technical challenges, support new product introductions and provide valuable feedback that helps shape future product development.

  • Troubleshoot complex networking, media transport and interoperability issues.

  • Develop, configure and troubleshoot Crestron, Q-SYS and Node-RED integrations.
  • Configure and optimise professional DSP platforms.
  • Support customers through deployment, commissioning and post-installation optimisation.
  • Work closely with Engineering and Product teams to investigate technical issues and contribute to future product development.
  • Produce technical documentation, knowledge base articles and best practice guidance.
  • Travel to customer sites when required (approximately 10–15%)

Essential:

  • Crestron programming

  • Digital Signal Processing (DSP)

Desirable:

  • Experience working for a professional AV manufacturer
  • Wireshark or other network diagnostic tools

job.title: Engagement Manager
job.description:
Christy Media Solutions is working with a global technology organisation to recruit an Engagement Manager (Americas) to join its Professional Services function in Mexico City.

This is a broad, customer-facing role combining technical project delivery, commercial scoping and customer leadership across the Americas. You will take ownership of Professional Services engagements from the presales stage, including scoping, quoting and Statements of Work, through planning and delivery to project closure and invoicing.

The position is approximately 60–70% hands-on project execution, alongside commercial/scoping activities and management responsibilities. You will coordinate three Technical Account Managers across the Americas and help drive a consistent approach to managed services and recurring revenue.

About the role

You will own the full Professional Services engagement lifecycle across the Americas, managing multiple customer-facing technical projects, typically 5–10 concurrent projects.

Acting as the primary customer contact and escalation point, you will manage project scope, planning, budgets, risks, quality, KPIs and profitability. You'll work closely with Sales on presales activities, including scoping, quoting and developing Statements of Work, while identifying potential upsell and expansion opportunities within existing customer accounts.

You'll also coordinate and support three Technical Account Managers across the region, manage project resourcing alongside the Delivery Manager, maintain accurate project information within Salesforce and contribute to the ongoing improvement of Professional Services processes and tools.

About you

You'll have a minimum of 5 years' experience in Professional Services, customer project management or engagement management within a technical environment, with experience managing customer projects across scope, planning, budget and quality.

You'll need experience of presales scoping, quoting and Statements of Work, alongside a strong commercial and revenue-focused mindset. Cybersecurity/security awareness and sufficient technical grounding to understand software delivery and integration projects are also important.

You should be comfortable managing multiple short-duration projects simultaneously, coordinating distributed cross-functional teams and communicating confidently with customers and internal stakeholders.

Fluent Spanish and English are required. Portuguese, media/content security or DRM experience, Salesforce knowledge and project management certifications such as PMP, Prince2 or Agile/Scrum would be advantageous.

What's on offer

This is an opportunity to take on a varied role spanning project delivery, commercial activity and team coordination, with exposure across LATAM and North America.

The Professional Services organisation is being developed into a more strategic and scalable profit centre. The position initially operates as an individual contributor role, with potential to progress into management and potentially take broader responsibility for the Engagement Manager team based on demonstrated leadership capability.

job.title: Vision Guarantee Engineer - IP
job.description:
Our client is a leading global provider of outside broadcast, live production and technical broadcast services, supporting some of the world’s largest sporting, entertainment and live television productions.

Operating across major live events, the company provides advanced outside broadcast facilities, flypacks, remote production systems and technical infrastructure to broadcasters, rights holders and production companies.

They are now looking for an experienced Guarantee-level Vision Engineer to join their UK engineering team.

The Role

This is a senior, hands-on engineering position responsible for the planning, preparation and delivery of complex vision systems across outside broadcast trucks, flypacks and remote production environments.

You will take technical ownership of vision systems from initial preparation and system configuration through to on-site delivery and live transmission.

On larger productions, you will work as part of a wider engineering operation. On smaller productions, you may be expected to take the technical lead, working independently and making key engineering decisions.

The role has a strong emphasis on video and vision engineering, combined with a working knowledge of modern IP and network-based broadcast infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take technical ownership of vision systems from preparation through to live delivery.
  • Lead the setup, configuration, testing and validation of OB and flypack systems.
  • Set up and support technical infrastructure at venues, including pitch-side production environments.
  • Engineer complex vision chains incorporating cameras, CCUs, vision mixers, routers, multiviewers, monitoring and tally systems.
  • Configure and troubleshoot video routing, signal distribution and monitoring systems.
  • Work across traditional SDI and hybrid SDI/IP production environments.
  • Support network-based broadcast infrastructure and IP-connected production equipment.
  • Integrate vision systems with replay, audio, communications and wider production infrastructure.
  • Act as the senior vision engineering authority on live productions when required.
  • Diagnose and resolve technical faults quickly in time-critical live environments.
  • Configure and support broadcast control, orchestration and monitoring systems.
  • Produce and maintain system diagrams, technical documentation and build records.
  • Contribute to improvements in system design, workflows, engineering standards and reliability.
  • Support and mentor less experienced engineers.

About You

You will be an experienced Vision, OB or Broadcast Engineer who is comfortable taking responsibility for technically complex live productions.

You should have strong hands-on knowledge of the complete video signal chain and be capable of setting up, configuring and troubleshooting systems independently in the field.

Experience working on major sports, entertainment, concert or other large-scale live productions would be particularly relevant.

Key Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience within outside broadcast, live production or complex live-event environments.
  • Hands-on experience with professional video and vision systems.
  • Strong understanding of video signal flow and routing.
  • Experience with professional broadcast cameras and CCUs.
  • Experience with vision mixers / production switchers.
  • Strong knowledge of routers, multiviewers, monitoring and signal distribution.
  • Excellent understanding of SDI-based production environments.
  • Experience with OB trucks, flypacks or portable production systems.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot technical problems during live productions.
  • Experience taking technical ownership of productions or leading smaller productions independently.
  • Ability to remain calm and decisive in time-critical live environments.
  • Strong planning, documentation and communication skills.

Relevant Backgrounds

We are particularly interested in engineers coming from:

  • Outside broadcast
  • Live sports production
  • Live television
  • Remote production
  • Major live events
  • Concert and touring production
  • High-end professional AV and video production

job.title: Network Engineer

Package

job.title: Electronic Design Engineer
job.description:
A leading broadcast & film production manufacturing organisation is looking to hire an Electronic Design Engineer to join their established team.

As Electronic Design Engineer you’ll play a key role in designing, developing, and testing complex electronic system, from circuit-level design to PCB layout and compliance testing. Working alongside a multi-disciplinary engineering team, you’ll help bring next-generation products from concept through production, supporting the full product lifecycle. Your work will directly contribute to new product introduction and the continuous improvement of existing systems.

Key Responsibilities Include:

  • Creating and capturing electronic circuit designs and schematics

  • Designing PCB layouts and preparing manufacturing-ready files

  • Programming components to meet performance requirements

  • Testing and troubleshooting down to component level

  • Supporting EMC and safety compliance testing to international standards

  • Collaborating with third-party manufacturers and engineering partners

  • Documenting your designs and maintaining a robust parts library

  • Contributing to product specifications and development plans

What You Bring

Essential Skills:

  • Strong background in analog and digital circuit design

  • Experience with microprocessors and programmable logic

  • Proficiency in schematic capture and PCB layout tools (e.g., PADs, Mentor Graphics)

  • Comfortable working under deadlines and collaborating with global teams

Who You Are

You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field, with a solid foundation in designing reliable, scalable electronics systems. You’re detail-oriented, proactive, and thrive in a fast-paced, technically challenging environment. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines and geographies, and you're always looking to refine and improve the tools and technologies you work with.

Work Environment & Flexibility

While primarily based in the UK, this role is part of a global engineering team, so flexibility is built into the role to support collaboration across time zones. Travel is minimal, and you’ll benefit from a hybrid and adaptive working model designed to support both productivity and work-life balance.
